title: Extract contents of a .pkg file
summary: Unpack the contents of an installer package into a folder without installing it. This lets you inspect or copy files from the package directly.

steps.explain: Use pkgutil to expand the full contents of a .pkg file into a specified directory.

placeholders.name: PKG_FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the .pkg file to extract

placeholders.name: OUTPUT_DIR
placeholders.description: Path to the directory where contents will be extracted
